content: Domestic flights are reimbursed up to $800 per trip for economy class. Business class requires VP-level approval and must be justified by flight duration exceeding 6 hours. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of travel completion.

International flights are reimbursed up to $2,500 for economy and $4,500 for business class. All international travel requires pre-approval from department head at least 14 days in advance. Per diem rates vary by country and are published in Appendix B.

Employees accrue vacation days based on tenure: 15 days/year for 0-2 years, 20 days/year for 2-5 years, and 25 days/year for employees with more than 5 years of service. Unused vacation may be carried over up to 5 days annually.

Employees with more than 5 years of service receive additional benefits including enhanced retirement matching (6% vs 4%), priority enrollment in leadership development programs, and eligibility for sabbatical leave after 7 years.

Paid Time Off (PTO) encompasses vacation, personal days, and floating holidays. PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance for absences under 3 days, and 15 business days for longer absences. Manager approval is required.

Sick leave is separate from PTO and provides 10 paid sick days per calendar year. Sick leave does not carry over between years. Documentation from a healthcare provider is required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive sick days.

Parental leave provides 16 weeks of fully paid leave for primary caregivers and 6 weeks for secondary caregivers. Leave must begin within 12 months of birth or adoption. Employees must have completed 12 months of service to be eligible.

Customer data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Access to customer data requires role-based permissions and multi-factor authentication. All access is logged and audited quarterly.

Customer data retention is limited to the period necessary for service delivery plus 90 days. Data deletion requests must be processed within 30 days. Third-party processors must sign data processing agreements and undergo annual security assessments.

Security incidents must be reported to the Security Operations Center within 1 hour of discovery. Initial triage includes containment, evidence preservation, and stakeholder notification. Use the incident portal or call the 24/7 hotline at ext. 5555.

Escalation path: Level 1 (SOC Analyst) → Level 2 (Senior Security Engineer) → Level 3 (CISO). Critical incidents affecting >1000 customers or involving data breach require CISO notification within 30 minutes and executive briefing within 4 hours.

Chief Technology Officer: Dr. Sarah Chen. Reports to CEO. Oversees Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams. Office location: Building A, Floor 5. Direct reports include VP Engineering, VP Infrastructure, and CISO.

All company devices must have endpoint protection enabled and updated within 24 hours of release. USB storage devices are prohibited unless explicitly whitelisted by IT Security. Personal devices connecting to corporate network require MDM enrollment.

Data classification labels must be applied to all documents containing sensitive information. Labels include Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted. Sharing Confidential or Restricted data externally requires DLP approval and encryption.

Email attachments are limited to 25MB per message. Files exceeding this limit must be shared via the approved cloud storage platform. Executable files (.exe, .bat, .sh) are blocked regardless of size. Compressed archives are scanned before delivery.

Customer data stored in cloud environments must use company-managed encryption keys. Shared responsibility model applies: IT manages infrastructure security, application teams manage data access controls. Annual compliance certification is mandatory.

Q3 All-Hands Meeting: September 15, 2026, 2:00 PM - 3:30 PM PDT. Hybrid format with in-person attendance at HQ Auditorium and virtual streaming via Teams. Agenda includes Q2 results review, product roadmap update, and employee recognition.

Managers may approve expenses up to $2,000 without additional authorization. Directors may approve up to $5,000. Expenses between $5,000-$10,000 require VP approval. All expenses over $10,000 require CFO sign-off and board notification.

Expenses over $5,000 require detailed business justification, three vendor quotes where applicable, and budget code verification. Approval workflow routes through manager → director → finance reviewer. Average processing time is 5-7 business days.

Emergency expenses over $5,000 may receive expedited approval via phone authorization from authorized approver, followed by written confirmation within 48 hours. Emergency designation requires documented business-critical impact and cannot be used for planning deficiencies.

Software license requests: Submit ticket via ServiceNow with software name, version, business justification, and cost center. Standard licenses are auto-approved if in catalog. Non-standard licenses require manager approval and security review. Fulfillment SLA: 3 business days.

Client meetings require business professional attire: suits or dress slacks/skirts with collared shirts or blouses. Smart casual is acceptable for internal-only meetings. Company-branded apparel is permitted on designated casual Fridays.

Main Office: 1200 Innovation Drive, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105. Hours: Mon-Fri 8AM-6PM PT. Visitor check-in at lobby reception. Parking validated for guests. Nearest public transit: Montgomery St BART (0.3 miles).

To reset VPN password: 1) Visit self-service portal at vpn.company.com/reset 2) Authenticate with current credentials or backup codes 3) Create new password meeting complexity requirements 4) Allow 5 minutes for sync. If locked out, contact Help Desk at ext. 4357.

Q3 Performance Review Deadline: August 30, 2026. Self-assessments due August 15. Manager reviews due August 25. Calibration sessions scheduled September 1-5. Results communicated to employees by September 15. Late submissions require HR exception approval.

Payroll Department: payroll@company.com, ext. 3200. Hours: Mon-Fri 9AM-5PM PT. For urgent pay issues outside business hours, use emergency line ext. 3201. Average response time: 1 business day. Escalation: Finance Manager Jane Smith, ext. 3205.

Remote work is permitted up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Core collaboration hours are 10AM-3PM local time. Employees must maintain dedicated workspace with reliable internet. Equipment stipend of $500 available upon request.

Remote work is permitted up to 3 days per week. Fully remote arrangements require director approval and quarterly performance review. Core hours reduced to 11AM-2PM local time. Equipment stipend increased to $750. Home office safety checklist required annually.

Remote Work Policy v2 (Effective Jan 15, 2026): Employees may work remotely up to 3 days/week. Fully remote requires director approval. Core hours: 11AM-2PM local. Equipment stipend: $750. Annual home office safety checklist required. Performance expectations unchanged. Policy supersedes v1.

Q1 2026 Revenue: $42.3M (+8% YoY). Operating margin: 12.4%. Key drivers: Enterprise segment growth (+15%), APAC expansion (+22%). Challenges: SMB churn increased 3pp. Cash position: $18.7M. Headcount: 342 FTEs.

Q2 2026 Revenue: $44.1M (+12% YoY, +4.3% QoQ). Operating margin: 13.1%. Key drivers: New product launch contributed $2.1M, EMEA recovery (+18%). SMB churn stabilized. Cash position: $20.3M. Headcount: 358 FTEs.

Q3 2025 Regional Revenue: APAC $8.2M (+19% YoY), EMEA $11.4M (+7% YoY), Americas $19.8M (+5% YoY). APAC led growth driven by Japan enterprise deals. EMEA impacted by currency headwinds. Total revenue: $39.4M.

APAC Revenue Growth Q3 2025: Japan +28%, Australia +15%, Singapore +12%, India +8%. Total APAC: $8.2M. Growth drivers: Enterprise contracts (65% of new bookings), Channel partnerships (25%). Currency impact: -2pp reported growth.
Q3 2025 Revenue: $39.4M (+9% YoY). Operating margin: 11.8%. APAC was fastest-growing region at +19%. Product revenue grew 14%, services flat. Cash position: $16.9M. Guidance raised for Q4.

APAC Revenue Growth Q4 2025: Japan +32%, Australia +18%, Singapore +14%, India +11%. Total APAC: $9.1M. Full-year APAC: $31.2M (+21% YoY). Q4 drivers: Year-end enterprise budgets, expanded channel program.

Engineering new hire training: Week 1-2 covers codebase architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and security practices. Weeks 3-4 include pair programming with mentor and first production PR. Required certifications: Secure coding, Cloud platform fundamentals. Total duration: 4 weeks.

Sales new hire training: Week 1 covers product knowledge and competitive landscape. Weeks 2-3 focus on sales methodology, CRM proficiency, and objection handling. Week 4 includes shadow calls and certification exam. Ongoing coaching monthly. Total duration: 4 weeks.

Decisions made: 1) Prioritize mobile app redesign for Q4. 2) Delay API v3 launch to Q1 2027. 3) Approve $150K budget for user research. Action items assigned to Product Lead and UX Director. Next review: August 22.

Action items from sprint planning: 1) Backend team to complete auth refactor by Aug 27. 2) QA to finalize test plan for payment flow. 3) DevOps to provision staging environment. Second priority item (payment flow testing) flagged as at-risk due to resource constraints.

All production deployments require automated testing coverage ≥80%, peer review approval, and rollback plan documented. Hotfixes exempt from coverage requirement but require post-deployment test addition within 48 hours. Policy effective March 2026.

August 2026 Updates: v2.4.1 deployed Aug 5 (performance improvements, bug fixes). v2.4.2 deployed Aug 19 (security patches CVE-2026-1234, CVE-2026-1235). Upcoming: v2.5.0 scheduled Sep 2 with new reporting dashboard. Subscribe to #releases channel for notifications.
